essence: Writing the enemy's name smeared with feces constitutes the prescribed ritual act.

essence: The practitioner possesses the power to disturb the worlds through mere vision.
Performing an oblation with honey-anointed substances pleases Kālakarṇī.
The mantrin must constantly remember the goddess who produces various wonders.
Once accomplished, Mahābhayā bestows an elixir upon the practitioner.
The elixir frees the practitioner from aging signs and disease.

essence: The practitioner can accomplish both the revival of the dead and the animation of an image through the prescribed rite.
Through the practice one certainly gains the power to attract leaves, flowers, fruits, and the like.
The practitioner receives one rūpyaka daily from Maṇibhadra.
Daily recitation of a thousand must be continued until a dream arises.
Upon completing a hundred thousand recitations, the accomplished ocean-servant bestows a gift.
